This is a demonstrated authority-publication boundary; it does not mean that existing imported-record runtime execution is absent.

I require an exact map from checked declaration/module identity to published ordinary-record authority through both producers, including imported and generic identities, same-spelled declarations, field layouts, arrays and forward references. I must retain conservative refusal when identity/layout/ownership cannot be proved and preserve verified runtime semantics. I must not fill missing authority from short-name guesses or treat advisory metadata as verifier proof.

I will implement reviewed bounded slices with positive paired publication/VM/native execution, mismatched or forged authority refusals, unchanged prior-output behavior, fresh compiler generations and Linux/Darwin evidence. The full row stays open until all required applicable source paths are qualified. Existing managed cycle/alias/runtime tests remain required and separate; optional translator refusals do not add release scope.
